question: If WIRE is coded as SENA, then REPORT will be coded as?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

The logic here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d37ce8afd1b5799ce7ba977b738adb43d7d8125501de404fe9c2379cc85a059.png] 

So, the WIRE is coded as SENA.

Similarly, the word REPORT is coded as NALKNP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3d9cf4427911fc5fef4ba842478265acb4fd8ade7995c3b7bc97f9d1faebd01.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
